First run

This page is example text, written for this site.

What happens

Bothy asks Docker what is running and lists it as services. It does not change those containers.

  • Open Services to see what it found.
  • Open Files to read the notes kept beside them.

Check it yourself

shdocker compose ps

The same containers should appear in both places.
